# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**My top pick: Soundcore Space One (about $80 with a code)**
- Best Products ranks it the best overall under $100. It has adaptive ANC, a 55-hour battery, rotating ear cups and a full EQ app. It's a bit heavy.
- Dealectric lists it at $99.99, or **$80 with code AFSC20**, last tested in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22. Check the price at checkout.
- [Buy the Soundcore Space One](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). Dealectric earns a commission on this link at no cost to you.
- Source: https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/

**Other good options**
- **Anker Soundcore Space Q45 (about $100):** RTINGS calls it the best budget ANC headphone it has tested, with excellent noise isolation that quiets engine rumble and chatty coworkers. RTINGS measured 28 hours of battery, while CartIQ claims 50, so I'd trust RTINGS's tested figure. Some owners report the headband cracking, so treat it gently. [RTINGS review with price links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024):** It nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation for less money, with 49 hours of battery. It has weaker bass-rumble cancelling, a plastic build and earpads that can flake. [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Sony WH-CH720N (about $99):** It's very light at 192 g and has strong ANC for HVAC hum and keyboard noise. It only supports SBC and AAC, with no LDAC. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **JBL Tune 760NC (about $79):** It has a bass-heavy sound and the best mic in RTINGS's under-$100 group. Its ANC is only average, and RTINGS notes its price fluctuates. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)
- **Edifier Atom Max (about $45):** The best value pick. It has hybrid ANC, a 45-hour battery and a foldable design, but no 3.5mm jack. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **1More SonoFlow (about $65):** TechRadar's under-$100 pick, with customizable sound. CartIQ describes the SonoFlow SE as having a 70-hour battery but weaker ANC. [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Quick guide**
- Best ANC for the money: Space One or Space Q45
- Lightest: Sony WH-CH720N
- Tightest budget: Edifier Atom Max
- Best for calls: JBL Tune 760NC

Prices change often, so confirm at checkout. The CartIQ page also contradicts itself on its top pick (the header says Sony, the text says Anker), so I leaned on RTINGS and Best Products where they differ.
